one_liner: FTV is a configurable video player app for Hyperfy, supporting up to five videos, playback controls, and optional spatial audio.
primary_use_case: In-world video playback with a customizable playlist, UI controls, and optional sound effects, allowing creators to embed interactive screens in their worlds.
preview_recommendation: Run the app in a test scene with a single video to verify playback, then add more videos and test UI responsiveness.
manifest_quality_notes: Interaction modes align with UI design
